newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: COMMISSION LAUNCHES MAZHEIKIU ADVISOR TENDER.
newsitem.headline: COMMISSION LAUNCHES MAZHEIKIU ADVISOR TENDER.

text.p: Lithuania's open tender commission said on Tuesday it sent invitations to 20 foreign banks and firms to participate in the bid to become the government's advisor on Mazheikiu Nafta privatisation.

The European affairs ministry said in a statement that invitations for a tender to become the advisor on the refinery's privatisation were sent to Deutche Morgan Grenfell, JP Morgan, UBS, Citibank NA and Merill Lynch.
It also said that letters were sent to Banque Paribas, Societe Generale and Banque Nationale de Paris.

"The main task for the advisor will be to audit Mazheikiu Nafta, to draw a share sell off contract, to check the reliability of the investor and to help to carry out the negotiations," the statement said.
The statement also said that the deadline to submit the offers for the tender would be September 12.
"We expect to decide on the winner of the tender around one week after the deadline," the head of tender commission, Vytenis Junevichius, told Reuters.
He also said that the privatisation tender for the only oil refinery in the country might be launched before the end of the year.
Mazheikiu Nafta oil refinery is 90 percent state owned.
